controls.name: policies and scopes
controls.what: each member's policy.json names the paths it may write; admin/build/agents.py check lists every file a member changed outside them

fired.what: agents.py flagged CLAUDE.md as outside the conductor's scope; the post-review asked for it to be named

controls.stopped: an unnamed write outside scope going unremarked
controls.missed: to research: it reports, it does not refuse; the write was allowed by the editor and still landed before it was named

controls.name: the five-step wake
controls.what: plan, pre-review, work, post-review, post-check, each a verdict in team/<id>/wakes/; wake.py gate refuses the work until plan and pre-review say go

fired.what: post-review finding: anonymous cookie values in captured headers, redacted in the same wake

controls.stopped: captured cookie values reaching the public record
controls.missed: to research: the record shows no pre-review that said change or stop; whether the step ever changed a plan is the open question

controls.name: holds
controls.what: any member writes team/<id>/HOLD.md and pushes it; every start.py then stops; only the editor lifts it

introduced.what: the schedule starts tonight, with a hold any member can pull

fired.what: the conductor's hold at the editor's word: his usage limit

controls.stopped: the team running the editor out of usage
controls.missed: to research: the one hold in the record came from the editor's word, not from a member's own stop

controls.name: session keys
controls.what: every session makes its own key with the pinned tool and publishes the public halves in team/<id>/key.json; the push is the authorisation
controls.fired: to find: a key checked against its session folder by the conductor

controls.name: the pinned key tool
controls.what: agents run a pinned copy of pki-agent.mjs, checked with sha256sum -c, instead of downloading it
controls.fired: this wake: the hash check passed before keygen (book repository)
controls.stopped: a changed copy being run unnoticed
controls.missed: the copy was never read line by line on the talk's team; review started: team/security/reviews/pki-agent-review.md

controls.name: the gate and its leak tripwire
controls.what: admin/build/validate.py fails the build on a private key, token-shaped value or em-dash in any tracked file
controls.fired: to find: a gate failure in the talk's history, and what it caught
controls.missed: to research: patterns only; a secret without a known shape passes

controls.name: the editor's signed decisions
controls.what: options go in as open decisions; nobody acts on an unsigned one; nobody speaks for the editor

controls.name: public vaults and vault_check

fired.what: vault_check clean on all three vaults, recorded in the post-review
